result.rationale: Low-energy inversion sprain with mild swelling and no bony tenderness at malleoli or midfoot, but the Ottawa ankle rule cannot be fully applied because weight-bearing (4 steps immediately and now) is unknown. Advise RICE and a gentle weight-bearing trial; clinician review is warranted to complete the assessment and determine whether imaging is needed. No red flags (deformity, numbness, open wound) requiring urgent escalation.
